finalText:
All tests now pass. The leak was in `processOrder.js` — it was acquiring a connection but not wrapping the release in a try/finally, so when `run()` threw an error (invalid order), the connection never went back to the pool. Each failed order left a connection stuck in the "in use" set. After about a dozen failures, all 5 connections were exhausted and the service went down.

The comment in the code said the direct acquire/release pattern was needed for a retry loop that no longer exists, so wrapping it in try/finally fixes both the leak and the tests.
